summary: Seabridge Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its spin-out of Valor Gold Corp. via a statutory plan of arrangement under the Canada Business Corporation Act, effective June 3, 2026. Seabridge transferred its 100% interest in the Courageous Lake gold project to Valor. Each Seabridge share was exchanged for one new Seabridge share and approximately one Valor share per 1.957 Seabridge shares held, resulting in 55,000,000 Valor shares outstanding. The Supreme Court of British Columbia approved the arrangement on May 27, 2026. Old Seabridge shares were suspended from trading on June 4, 2026, with new Seabridge shares and Valor shares listing on June 5, 2026. Watch for Valor's OTCQB listing and post-spin valuation.
